# Alper Refrigerants

> Refrigerants, air conditioners, heat pumps and HVAC tools for professional buyers.

Alper Refrigerants is the trading name of Alper Chemical Group. The canonical website is https://alperrefrigerants.com. Contact sales@alperrefrigerants.com or +1-786-987-0501. Business address: 382 NE 191st St, Miami, FL 33179, United States.

Use the current product page for specifications, price, availability and packaging. Refrigerant selection depends on equipment compatibility and destination requirements; alternatives are not automatically drop-in replacements. Shipping, taxes and compliance requirements depend on the order and destination. This directory does not replace manufacturer documentation or store policies.
